inputs.text: According to Bloomberg, every day, as energy prices rise, flights are canceled and death and destruction fill screens, people across the world ask when the Iran war — widely viewed as poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being — will stop. Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]
